user.title: Fuelio data source
user.description: Choose where the CSV export is stored and how often it should be checked. Google Drive is accessed through an externally synchronized file; this integration does not connect to Google Drive directly.

file.title: CSV file location
file.description: Enter the full path to the CSV file. For Google Drive, synchronize the ZIP export to Home Assistant (for example with rclone and an SMB network share), then point to the extracted CSV.

error.cannot_read_file: The file could not be read or is not a valid Fuelio CSV export.
